title: Dynasty Charity Half Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: Dynasty Charity Half Marathon Review: Miri Course, Humidity, Cut-offs
meta_description: Dynasty Charity Half Marathon review from the 2025 race: a 4am start in Miri at 25°C and 94% humidity, a coastal out-and-back, a 4-hour cut-off, RM95-115 entry and prizes ten deep.
dek: What the Miri hotel's charity half marathon was like in October 2025: the city loop and coast road, the saturated pre-dawn air, the water stations and cut-offs, how fast the winners ran, and what changes for 2026.
verdict: Enter if you are in or near Miri and want a cheap, early-morning half marathon with a real chance of prize money. In 2025 the 21 km started at 4am from Dynasty Hotel Miri, ran a city loop and then out and back along the coast, and cost RM95 to RM115. Cash prizes went ten deep, and tenth place in the women's open took RM200 in 1:49:51. The catch is the air: 25°C and 94% to 100% humidity with almost no wind, plus a climb at Bukit Tanjung. Note that the 2026 cut-off is 7.30am, half an hour earlier than in 2025.

sections.heading: The Course: A City Loop, Then the Coast Road
paragraphs: The 21 km starts and finishes on Jalan Miri-Pujut outside Dynasty Hotel. On the 2025 route map it first loops north through the city centre, past a checkpoint at Miri City Fan and back by Imperial Mall and Bintang Megamall, then heads south-west past Wisma Pelita Tunku and the padang onto Jalan Brighton. From there it runs along the coast past Miri Marriott Resort & Spa and Tanjung Lobang beach to a checkpoint and turn near Beach Republic, and comes back the same way [1]. The 10 km follows the same city loop but turns at the Marriott [1].

The police list of roads used includes Jalan Miri-Pujut, Jalan Bintang, Jalan Sylvia, Jalan Brooke, Jalan Kubu, Jalan Brighton, Jalan Luak/Esplanade and Jalan Melayu [2]. No elevation profile is published, but it is not all flat: one 21 km runner in 2025 said the climb at Bukit Tanjung was very tough [3]. The 2026 map shows the same shape, and names the coastal stretch Jalan Tanjung Lobang [4].

sections.heading: The Weather: Saturated Air From the Start
paragraphs: Miri airport, which the organiser's 2026 map shows just inland of the course's southern turn, recorded 25°C at the 4am start, with a dew point of 24°C, 94% humidity and a 1-knot wind [5]. From 5am to 7am the humidity read 100% at 24°C to 25°C. It warmed only at the end: 27°C and 89% humidity at 8am, when the 21 km closed, and 29°C at 9am [5].

A dew point of 24°C to 25°C means sweat barely evaporates, so the race is run in air that feels heavier than the temperature suggests. One runner stopped in the final stretch in 2025 to help a runner who had cramped, having limped home with a cramped leg themselves in 2024 [6].

sections.heading: Aid Stations, Cut-offs and Roads
paragraphs: The 2025 21 km map marks seven water stations, most of them on the coastal out-and-back, which runners pass in both directions, plus checkpoints at Miri City Fan and at the turn [1]. The map legend shows only water stations and checkpoints.

In 2025 the half marathon had four hours, from the 4am flag-off to an 8am cut-off; the 10 km ran from 6.15am to 7.45am and the 4 km fun run from 6.20am to 7.20am [1]. For 2026 the 21 km cut-off moves to 7.30am, so the limit falls to three and a half hours, and the organiser says runners who do not finish get no medal and no finisher tee [4].
Police closed or diverted the route roads in stages from 3am to 8am, including the junctions at Bulatan Kipas, Jalan Brooke, Luak and the Marina junctions on Jalan Brighton [2][7].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The women's open 21 km was won in 1:25:03 by Alice Muthoni Koigi, ahead of Susan Jematai Kosgei in 1:29:05 and Jackline Nzivo in 1:32:10; fifth was 1:41:19 and tenth 1:49:51 [8]. Only the women's open results were posted publicly. On the men's side, one runner who finished the open 21 km in 1:30:25 said it was not enough for the top ten [3].

Prize money runs ten deep. In the 21 km open categories it goes from RM2,000 for first to RM200 for sixth to tenth, and the 21 km veteran categories, for runners 45 and over, pay RM1,500 down to RM200 [1]. A woman who can run under 1:50 has a real chance of a paid place in the open category.

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: Race packs were collected at Dynasty Hotel on the Friday and Saturday before the race, 17 and 18 October, from 10am to 6pm, with no collection on race day [1]. For 2026 the dates are 23 and 24 October at the same hotel [4].

The 21 km cost RM95 at the early-bird rate and RM115 after that, the 10 km RM65 or RM75 and the 4 km RM55 or RM65; the 2026 fees are the same [1][4]. Every entry includes an event tee, a medal, a bib and a door gift, and 21 km finishers also get a finisher tee [1]. Bibs are not transferable in 2026 [4].
The race raises money for the hotel's charity fund, which pays for festive goodie giveaways at Chinese New Year, Gawai and Hari Raya and other help for families in need [9].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a local half marathon in Miri with prize money ten deep and a coastal out-and-back, and you are happy to be on the start line at 4am. The 10 km and 4 km suit newer runners and families.
Think twice if you need a published elevation profile, lots of aid beyond water, or you are a slow half marathoner: the 2026 limit is three and a half hours, not four.
The organiser's 2026 pages give the date, start times, cut-offs, fees and route map. They do not describe aid beyond the water stations on the map, so ask the organiser if you need more.

Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's registration pages and route maps, police road-closure notices reported by local media, the posted women's results, airport weather records and two runners' own posts.

faqs.question: What time does the Dynasty Charity Half Marathon start?
faqs.answer: Early. In 2025 the 21 km flagged off at 4am, the 10 km at 6.15am and the 4 km fun run at 6.20am, all from Dynasty Hotel Miri on Jalan Miri-Pujut. The organiser's 2026 pages keep the same start times, with the 21 km again at 4am on Sunday 25 October.

faqs.question: What is the cut-off for the 21 km at the Dynasty Charity Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: It is getting shorter. In 2025 the half marathon closed at 8am, four hours after the 4am start. For 2026 the organiser lists a 7.30am cut-off, three and a half hours, and says runners who do not finish get no finisher medal and no finisher tee.

faqs.question: How humid is the Dynasty Charity Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Very. At the 4am start in 2025, Miri airport recorded 25°C, a dew point of 24°C, 94% humidity and a 1-knot wind. The humidity read 100% from 5am to 7am, and it reached 27°C and 89% humidity at the 8am cut-off. Pace for the humidity, not the temperature.

faqs.question: Is there prize money at the Dynasty Charity Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Yes, ten deep. In 2025 the 21 km open paid RM2,000 for first down to RM200 for sixth to tenth, and the 21 km veteran categories for runners 45 and over paid RM1,500 down to RM200. Tenth place in the women's open took RM200 in 1:49:51.

faqs.question: Where do you collect the race pack for the Dynasty Charity Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: At Dynasty Hotel Miri, on the Friday and Saturday before the race. In 2025 that was 17 and 18 October, 10am to 6pm, with no collection on race day. For 2026 the organiser lists 23 and 24 October, 10am to 6pm, at the same hotel.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 to the review template. Written about the previous edition (Sunday 19 October 2025, the 21st). Weather is from Miri airport METAR observations, not a forecast. Only the women's open 21 km top ten was publicly posted; men's results come only from one runner's post. The TVS post-race report (field size, charity totals) was blocked and is not used; Borneo Post and See Hua were also blocked.
